name: Reference soil Germany 14
summary: A deep, dark grassland-type soil formed in wind-blown loess, a close relative of the Mollisols of the Great Plains. Earthworms and burrowing animals have mixed humus far down into the profile, over pale, lime-bearing loess.
credit: Photo: ISRIC World Soil Reference Collection, CC BY-SA 3.0 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ISRIC_monolith_DE-014.jpg — Site and horizon data condensed from ISRIC – World Soil Information https://isis.isric.org/monoliths/reference-soil-de014 — Feature notes written for this site.

horizons.name: Ah1
horizons.description: Dark brown (7.5YR 3/2 moist) silt loam; strong fine subangular blocky and crumb structure; very friable; gradual smooth boundary.

horizons.name: Ah2
horizons.description: Dark brown (7.5YR 3.5/2 moist) silt loam; fine subangular blocky and strong fine crumb structure; very friable; abrupt irregular boundary.

horizons.name: Ah3
horizons.description: Very dark brown (7.5YR 2/2 moist) silt loam; strong fine subangular blocky structure; very friable; broken clay cutans in root channels and pores; clear irregular boundary.

horizons.name: BC
horizons.description: Silt loam; strong fine and medium angular and subangular blocky structure; very friable; broken clay cutans; krotovinas; clear irregular boundary.

horizons.name: Cg
horizons.description: Yellow (10YR 7/6 moist) silt loam (loess); weak angular blocky to porous massive; common fine distinct mottles (10YR 7/2, 10YR 6/8); calcareous concretions.

features.title: Root
features.description: Roots grow throughout the humus layer; when they die they leave channels and organic matter behind.

features.title: Earthworm channel
features.description: Open channel left by an earthworm. Worms mix organic matter deep into Chernozems.

features.title: Old root channel
features.description: A thick decaying root running down through the topsoil.

features.title: Biopore
features.description: Round pore from roots or soil fauna. Pores like this let water and air move quickly downward.

features.title: Krotovina
features.description: Burrow of a small mammal, filled with dark topsoil from above. Light and dark patches like this are typical at the base of Chernozems.

features.title: Humus tongue
features.description: Dark topsoil material reaching down into the loess along old channels and burrows.

features.title: Dark speck
features.description: Small dark (manganese) speck in the loess.

features.title: Loess
features.description: Wind-blown silt deposited during the last ice age, the same kind of parent material as much of Kansas.
